class.name: Ranger (Himo)

tools: Uno a elegir entre Cazador, Peletero, Envenenador o Herborista

default: (a) 2 Shortswords o (b) 2 Armas simples a melé.
(a) Pack de Dunjeon o (b) Pack de explorador.

entries: Este rework pretende ayudar al ranger a desempeñar un rol útil en combate (DPS), sin perder su utilidad fuera de combate y el flavor. Además se pretende también arreglar su economía de acción.
Las variantes de Tasha se han añadido al rework o se han eliminado. Si no las ves reflejadas, es que han sido eliminadas y ya no son una opción que puedas escoger.
CD = 8 + BC + Wisdom

classFeatures: Mejoras Favored Foe y Explorador Natural|Ranger (Himo)|Himo|6|Himo

classFeature.name: Enemigo Predilecto
entries: Elige un tipo de criatura entre todos los que hay. Si era humanoide, en su lugar escoge 2 razas. Tienes ventaja en checks de wisdom en inteligencia para recabar información sobre ellos y trackear y hablas un idioma asociado a ese enemigo. Además, al atacar haces {@damage 1d4} extra al daño de cada ataque.

Además, un número de veces al día igual a tu BC, puedes usar la bonus para marcar a un enemigo. Si no era un enemigo predilecto, haces el daño extra como si lo fuera. Si ya lo era, tiras un dado extra.
A los lv 6 y 14 eliges un enemigo extra y el dado de daño aumenta en 1 lv ({@damage d6} y {@damage d8}).

classFeature.name: Explorador Natural
entries: Elige un terreno entre árctico, costa, desierto, bosque, pradera, montaña, pantano, urbano, mar, wildspace, zona volcánica o Underdark. Ganas los siguientes bonos:

items: Se te considera experto en cualquier check de wisdom o inteligencia relacionado con tu terreno.
El terreno difícil no frena la velocidad de viaje de tu grupo
No puedes perderte excepto por medios mágicos
Permaneces alerta en todo momento durante el viaje
Cuando forrajeas, consigues el doble de comida
Cuando trackeas criaturas, descubres su número exacto, tamaños y hace cuánto pasaron por ahí.

entries: Ganas nuevos terrenos a lv 6 y 10.

classFeature.name: Estilo de Lucha
entries: At 2nd level, you adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options. You can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.

entries.name: Archery
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

entries.name: Close Quarters Shooter
entries: When making a ranged attack while you are within 5 feet of a hostile creature, you do not have disadvantage on the attack roll. Your ranged attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover against targets within 30 feet of you. You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls on ranged attacks.

entries.name: Defense
entries: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

entries.name: Dueling
entries: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

entries.name: Mariner
entries: As long as you are not wearing heavy armor or using a shield, you have a swimming speed and a climbing speed equal to your normal speed, and you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

entries.name: Tunnel Fighter
entries: As a bonus action, you can enter a defensive stance that lasts until the start of your next turn. While in your defensive stance, you can make opportunity attacks without using your reaction, and you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against a creature that moves more than 5 feet while within your reach.

entries.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
entries: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

entries.name: Blind Fighting
entries: Being unable to see a creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your attack rolls against it, provided the creature isn't hidden from you.

entries.name: Interception
entries: When a creature you can see hits a target that is within 5 feet of you with an attack, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage the target takes by {@dice 1d10} + your proficiency bonus (to a minimum of 0 damage). You must be wielding a shield or a simple or martial weapon to use this reaction.

entries.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
entries: You can draw a weapon that has the thrown property as part of the attack you make with the weapon.
In addition, when you hit with a ranged attack using a thrown weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to the damage roll.

entries.name: Unarmed Fighting
entries: Your unarmed strikes can deal bludgeoning damage equal to {@dice 1d6} + your Strength modifier. If you strike with two free hands, the {@dice d6} becomes a {@dice d8}.

When you successfully start a grapple, you can deal {@dice 1d4} bludgeoning damage to the grappled creature. Until the grapple ends, you can also deal this damage to the creature whenever you hit it with a melee attack.

entries.name: Druidic Warrior
entries: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the {@filter druid spell list|spells|level=0|class=druid}. They count as druid spells for you, and Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can replace one of these cantrips with another cantrip from the druid spell list.

classFeature.name: Spellcasting
entries: By the time you reach 2nd level, you have learned to use the magical essence of nature to cast spells, much as a druid does. See {@book chapter 10|PHB|10} for the general rules of spellcasting and chapter 11 for the {@filter ranger spell list|spells|class=Ranger (Himo)}.

entries.name: Spell Slots
entries: The Ranger table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your {@filter ranger spells|spells|class=Ranger (Himo)} of 1st level and higher. To cast one of these spells, you must expend a slot of the spell's level or higher. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest.
For example, if you know the 1st-level spell {@spell animal friendship} and have a 1st-level and a 2nd-level spell slot available, you can cast {@spell animal friendship} using either slot.

entries.name: Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher
entries: You know two 1st-level spells of your choice from the ranger spell list.

The Spells Known column of the Ranger table shows when you learn more ranger spells of your choice. Each of these spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For instance, when you reach 5th level in this class, you can learn one new spell of 1st or 2nd level.

Additionally, when you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the ranger spells you know and replace it with another spell from the ranger spell list, which also must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

entries.name: Spellcasting Ability
entries: Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your ranger spells, since your magic draws on your attunement to nature. You use your Wisdom whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Wisdom modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a ranger spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

classFeature.name: Ágil y Experto
entries: Puedes dashear y esconderte con la bonus. Además, escoge una de tus competencias de skill o herramienta, ahora tienes expertise.

classFeature.name: Subclase
entries: En el nivel 3, eliges un Ranger Archetype de la lista de subclases disponibles. Tu elección te otorga rasgos en el nivel 3 y de nuevo en los niveles 7, 11 y 15.

classFeature.name: Consciencia Primigenia
entries: Como acción, puedes gastar un slot de conjuro de lv 1 o superior para conocer la presencia de cualquier cualquier aberración, celestial, dragón, elemental, fey, fiend y undead a una milla de ti. Si no estás en tu terreno predilecto, no sabes cuántas hay o dónde están ni qué o quiénes son, solo si hay o no. Si estás en tu terreno predilecto, podrás saber en qué dirección están y hacia dónde se mueven. La distancia aumenta a un número de millas igual al lv de conjuro.

classFeature.name: Golpe Medido
entries: Ganas un dado de superioridad igual al dado de tu enemigo predilecto y 2 {@filter opciones de maniobra|optionalfeatures|feature type=MV:B}. Recuperas los dados en descanso corto y la CD va sobre la fuerza o la destreza. Adquieres un dado y una opción más a los lv7, 13 y 17.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: When you reach 4th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a {@5etools feat|feats.html}.

classFeature.name: Multiataque
entries: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn.

classFeature.name: Cataplasmas
entries: Un número total de veces al día igual a tu BC y solo durante descansos corto, puedes aplicar una cataplasma medicinal a un número de criaturas voluntarias de tu elección. Esta cura una cantidad de HP igual a tu lv. Además, la cataplasma elimina cualquier veneno activo o cura 1 enfermedad. Tú eliges entre veneno o enfermedad, pero si aplicaban más de uno, el DM elige cuál se elimina.

classFeature.name: Móvil
entries: Tu velocidad caminando aumenta en 5 ft y adquieres velocidad de nado y trepado. Levantarte te cuesta solo 5 ft.

classFeature.name: Mejoras Favored Foe y Explorador Natural
entries: Eliges un enemigo extra y el dado de daño aumenta a {@damage 1d6}.
Ganas un nuevo terreno para tu Explorador Natural.

classFeature.name: Subclase
entries: Obtienes un nuevo rasgo de tu Ranger Archetype.

classFeature.name: Mejora Golpe Medido
entries: Adquieres un dado de superioridad y una opción de maniobra más.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: When you reach 8th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a {@5etools feat|feats.html}.

classFeature.name: Zancada de Tierra
entries: No se ve penalizado por terreno difícil mágico ni no mágico y puede usar una bonus para liberarse de un efecto que impida su movilidad. Si un terreno aplicaba un daño físico no mágico, es inmune a este daño.

classFeature.name: ¡A Cubierto!

entries.name: Evasion
entries: Beginning at 7th level, you can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain area effects, such as a red dragon's fiery breath or an {@spell ice storm} spell. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

Sin embargo, cuando tú y una criatura que puedas ver estéis sujetos a una salvación de destreza para recibir daño, puedes usar tu reacción para pasarle el rasgo de evasión a esa criatura, pero tu lo pierdes para este efecto.
Rasgo sujeto a testeo.

classFeature.name: Hide in Plain Sight
entries: Starting at 10th level, you can spend 1 minute creating camouflage for yourself. You must have access to fresh mud, dirt, plants, soot, and other naturally occurring materials with which to create your camouflage.

Once you are camouflaged in this way, you can try to hide by pressing yourself up against a solid surface, such as a tree or wall, that is at least as tall and wide as you are. You gain a +10 bonus to Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks as long as you remain there without moving or taking actions. Once you move or take an action or a reaction, you must camouflage yourself again to gain this benefit.
Una vez por descanso corto, como bonus, puedes hacerte invisible hasta el inicio de tu próximo turno.

classFeature.name: Incansable
entries: Un número de veces al día igual a tu modificador de Wisdom, puedes usar tu acción en ganar tu lv en HPT. Además, recuperas 1 punto de agotamiento por descanso corto.

classFeature.name: Mejora Explorador Natural
entries: Ganas un nuevo terreno para tu Explorador Natural.

classFeature.name: Subclase
entries: Obtienes un nuevo rasgo de tu Ranger Archetype.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: When you reach 12th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a {@5etools feat|feats.html}.

classFeature.name: Mejora Golpe Medido
entries: Adquieres un dado de superioridad y una opción de maniobra más.

classFeature.name: Danger Slayer
entries: Una vez por turno, puede doblar la cantidad de dados del Favored Foe que le haya puesto a un enemigo que no haya escogido como predilecto. Si sí era predilecto, puede escoger uno de los dados de enemigo predilecto y aplicar el daño máximo en vez de tirar dados. Además, los ataques contra enemigos predilectos siempre contarán como mágicos e ignorarán resistencias contra los daños físicos, de veneno.

classFeature.name: Mejora Favored Foe
entries: Eliges un enemigo extra y el dado de daño aumenta a {@damage 1d8}.

classFeature.name: Subclase
entries: Obtienes un nuevo rasgo de tu Ranger Archetype.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: When you reach 16th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a {@5etools feat|feats.html}.

classFeature.name: Mejora Golpe Medido
entries: Adquieres un dado de superioridad y una opción de maniobra más.

classFeature.name: Feral Senses
entries: Ganas blindsight a 30 ft o aumentas el que ya tuvieras en 30 ft. Con un slot de lv1 puedes darte thermalsense a 30 ft durante 1 minuto.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: When you reach 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a {@5etools feat|feats.html}.

classFeature.name: Foe Slayer
entries: Puede añadir Wisdom al ataque o al daño contra una criatura que haya targeteado, pero si era uno de sus enemigos predilectos, lo añade a ambos.
